item.title: Videos and Meeting Notes fromCNA Technical Workshop 2026Now Available
item.description: Videos and Meeting Notes fromCNA Technical Workshop 2026Now AvailableblogBy CVE Program|November 17, 2026Videos from 11 sessions of the virtualCNA Technical Workshop 2026, held October 29, 2026, are now available on theCVE Program Channel on YouTube. Meeting notes are availablehere. CVE Program workshops are a way for theCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)community to regularly collaborate on specific topics in a focused manner. Discussions are always informative, and many sessions result in creative recommendations from community members that directly impact and enhance the program.

item.title: Symfony Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: Symfony Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsNovember 17, 2026Symfonyis now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for all software published by the Symfony project in the symfony, twigphp, symfony-cli, symfony-tools, and symfonycorp GitHub organizations, including the corresponding packages distributed through Packagist under the symfony and twig vendor namespaces. This covers all versions, including end-of-life branches. Third-party packages that merely depend on Symfony or Twig, such as community bundles, are out of scope.

item.title: National Cyber Security Centre - United Kingdom Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: National Cyber Security Centre - United Kingdom Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsNovember 17, 2026National Cyber Security Centre - United Kingdom(NCSC-UK) is now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)and may assign a CVE ID and publish a CVE Record where all of the following apply: the vulnerability affects an industrial control system (ICS) or operational technology (OT) product; the affected product is developed or maintained by a UK-based company; the vulnerability is reported to, identified by, researched by or coordinated by the NCSC-UK; the NCSC-UK has reasonable evidence that a CVE-eligible vulnerability exists; the vulnerability has been, or is expected to be, publicly disclosed; and, no CNA with more appropriate scope is handling the assignment, or the case has been referred or escalated to the NCSC-UK in accordance with CVE Program processes. The NCSC-UK will not assign a CVE ID outside of the above scope. Where another CNA has more appropriate scope, the NCSC-UK will refer the request or coordinate with that CNA.
